newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel barge premiums drift, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel barge premiums drift, trade inactive.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was inactive on Tuesday with both demand and offers stagnant, traders said.
Feb IPE gas oil futures were $4.50 down at $214.50 a tonne, pushed lower by a technical fall on NYMEX crude and products.
Traders assessed barges around Feb +$30/31 fob ARA. Traders reported scattered demand for fob cargoes, putting levels notionally at Feb IPE +$25/26 fob ARA.
Traders said most shorts in the north were expected to roll over requirements into February, when barrels from the Med are due to arrive. The Med itself remains long, traders said.
